name: rolepark
description: Recruiting workflows for the RolePark applicant tracking system: a daily briefing, application review with a shortlist and interview scheduling, interview prep, candidate search in your own database, adding a candidate from a CV, creating a vacancy from a job description, reviewing incoming applications with screening answers, emailing candidates, interview scorecards, vacancy analytics, and pipeline updates for hiring managers. Claude works with your own RolePark access and asks before changing anything.
